body: Noted during T-89 (web fixed the equivalent). Android AuthInterceptor adds Authorization to every request including /login and /register when a token happens to exist. Not UI-reachable today (those calls only happen while logged out, token null), so latent — but if a logged-in code path ever hits them, a stale/valid token rides along and a 401 there would trigger the forced-logout path spuriously. Mirror the web fix (T-89 ab7e059): skip attaching the token on the auth endpoints. Files: android .../data/api/AuthInterceptor.kt (+ test). Cross-ref: T-89.
title: Android: AuthInterceptor attaches the bearer token to /login and /register
